report: Under the Weibull accelerated-failure-time model, cold-treated seeds had 1.70 times the germination time of controls (95% CI 1.35 to 2.13; p = 5.745e-06). This is a time ratio, not a Cox hazard ratio. The distributional fit and censoring assumptions remain part of the interpretation.
